title: Go a kos, gain a handful
literal_meaning: Go a kos, and a cupped handful is gained.
meaning_odia: ଜୀବିକା ପାଇଁ ଘରୁ ବାହାରି ଦୂରକୁ ଗଲେ ନୂଆ ରୋଜଗାରର ସୁଯୋଗ ମିଳିପାରେ। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ନିଜ ଗାଁ ବାହାରେ କାମ କରି ଅଧିକ ଆୟ କରିବାର ଆଶା ସହ ଏହି କଥାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ।
explanation: The short rhyme joins distance travelled with something gained. The inspected source applies it to earning a better livelihood away from one’s home village. It expresses the hope that venturing farther can open opportunities.
usage_example: A craftsperson finds buyers at a market beyond their village and recalls the saying about going farther to earn. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: କୋଶ names a traditional distance measure; ପୋଷ is the amount held in a cupped palm. Their rhyme compresses a journey and its hoped-for return into a few words, without naming a precise wage or quantity of goods.
